about: The Vail adapter keyer modes (#348), in the order the Keyer mode picker lists them and by the name it shows. The order is the Program Change number the adapter firmware assigns (0-9), so it is not cosmetic. Read by the Swift harness (where the enum is visible), the Kotlin tests on android and desktop, and by parity/check.py, which also checks that every Settings picker builds from the whole enum. Derived from the Vail firmware's mode table and the in-app picker, not from either port.
